He said. We have no way of increasing it, because we made a peace agreement with them.”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَى أُولَئِكَ سَبِيلٌ، إِنَّا صَالَحْنَاهُمْ

THE: Yahya said: 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mubarak named this man, who is mentioned before Ibrahim, saying that he was Muhammad ibn Zayd, and was a qadi at Khurasan.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ يُسَمِّي هَذَا الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي هُوَ دُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَقُولُ: هُوَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَكَانَ قَاضِيًا بِخُرَاسَانَ

THE: (393) He said: Sa<ld ibn 'Ufayr related to me from Yahya ibn Ayytlb from Yanus ibn Yazid al-Ayll from Ibn Shihab that 'Umar ibn al-Khattab used to charge, from those with whom a peace compact had been made, whatever they had agreed to pay, without decreasing this amount or increasing it.
كتاب الأموال: 391 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْأَيْلِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِمَّنْ صَالَحَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ مَا صَالَحَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَا يُضَيِّعُ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا، وَلَا يَزِيدُ عَلَيْهِمْ،

THE: In the case of those who had submitted on the condition of paying jizya without naming a fixed amount, he examined their case and if there was need he would lighten their payments, but if they were well off he would levy it according to their ability to pay.*
كتاب الأموال: وَمَنْ نَزَلَ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْجِزْيَةِ وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ شَيْئًا نَظَرَ عُمَرُ فِي أُمُورِهِمْ، فَإِنِ احْتَاجُوا خَفَّفَ عَنْهُمْ، وَإِنِ اسْتَغْنَوْا زَادَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقَدْرِ اسْتِغْنَائِهِمْ

THE: (394) He said. 'Abd Allah ibn Salih related a similar decision to us from al-Layth from Yunus from Ibn Shihab from <'Umar.
كتاب الأموال: 392 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ

THE: (395) He said: Sa<ld ibn Maryam related to us from Yahya ibn AyyQb from <'Ubayd Allah ibn Abi Ja'far, who said: “An aged shaykh from Egypt related to me that Mu^wiya wrote to Wardan: ‘Increase one carat for each Coptic.

كتاب الأموال: 393 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ [ص:191] أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي شَيْخٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِصْرَ قَدِيمٌ: أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ كَتَبَ إِلَى وَرْدَانَ: أَنْ «زِدْ عَلَى الْقِبْطِ قِيرَاطًا عَلَى كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ»

THE: ’ ardan wrote back saying: ‘How can I increase this for them when they have agreement that says that there will be no increase?’”
كتاب الأموال: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ وَرْدَانُ: كَيْفَ أَزِيدُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِي عَهْدِهِمْ أَنْ لَا يُزَادَ عَلَيْهِمْ؟

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: As for the tradition of 'Umar, about those with whom a peace agreement is made, that nothing is to be reduced for them or increased, it means that this is so when they retain their ability to pay.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: أَمَّا حَدِيثُ عُمَرَ فِي أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ: أَنَّهُ لَا يَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا فَلَا أُرَاهُ أَرَادَ إِلَّا مَا دَامُوا مُطِيقِينَ،

THE: If they are unable to pay, the amount has to be reduced in accordance with their ability.
كتاب الأموال: وَلَوْ عَجَزُوا لِخَفَّفَ عَنْهُمْ بِقَدْرِ طَاقَتِهِمْ،

THE: The reason is that the Messenger of God (pbuh) laid down that the amount would not be increased for them.
كتاب الأموال: لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَطَ أَنْ لَا يُزَادَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَشْتَرِطْ أَنْ يُنْقَصُوا،

THE: He did not direct that it is not to be reduced even when they have lost their ability to pay the levy.
كتاب الأموال: إِذَا كَانُوا عَاجِزِينَ عَنِ الْوَظِيفَةِ،

THE: Mu^wiya s letter to Wardan about the increase for Coptics was correct in our view because he was of the view that Egypt was conquered by the force of arms. An increase could, therefore, be permitted.
كتاب الأموال: وَأَمَّا كِتَابُ مُعَاوِيَةَ إِلَى وَرْدَانَ فِي الزِّيَادَةِ عَلَى الْقِبْطِ، فَإِنَّمَا نَرَى ذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ مِصْرَ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ عَنْوَةً فَلِهَذَا اسْتَجَازَ الزِّيَادَةَ،

THE: According to Wardan, however, it was annexed peacefully and he looked down upon an increase. This is why they disagreed.
كتاب الأموال: وَكَانَتْ عِنْدَ وَرْدَانَ صُلْحًا، فَكَرِهَ الزِّيَادَةَ فَلِهَذَا اخْتَلَفَا،

THE: We have already mentioned how people have differed about its annexation.
كتاب الأموال: وَقَدْ ذَكَرْنَا مَا كَانَ مِنَ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاسِ فِي افْتِتَاحِهَا

THE: The Terms of the Agreements Made With the Ahl al-Dhimma
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ الشُّرُوطِ الَّتِي اشْتُرِطَتْ عَلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ حِينَ صُولِحُوا وَأَقَرُّوا عَلَى دِينِهِمْ

THE: (393-A)' He (Abu <'Ubayd) said: Aba Mushir al-Dimashql and Yahya ibn Bukayr related to me from Malik ibn Anas from Nafi‘ from Aslam, who said: “‘Umar imposed jizya at the rate of forty dirhams on those who possessed silver and four dinars'* on those who possessed gold.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ: ضَرَبَ عُمَرُ الْجِزْيَةَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوَرِقِ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَمًا وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الذَّهَبِ أَرْبَعَةَ دَنَانِيرَ،

THE: Along with this an obligation for feeding the Muslims and providing them board for three days was also imposed.”
كتاب الأموال: وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ أَرْزَاقُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَضِيَافَةُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ

THE: (396) He said: Sharik related to us from Aba Ishaq from Haritha ibn Mudarrib, who said: “'Umar made it obligatory on the people of the Sawad to provide board and lodging for one day and night, and directed that whatever they had in their possession of food and fodder was not to be usurped.”’
كتاب الأموال: 394 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ الْمُضَرِّبِ [ص:192]، قَالَ: «جَعَلَ عُمَرُ الضِّيَافَةَ عَلَى أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً، وَلَا يَتَعَدَّى مَا عِنْدَهُمْ مِنْ طَعَامٍ أَوْ عَلَفٍ»

THE: (397) He said: Sufyan ibn 'Uyayna related to us from Abu Ishaq from Haritha ibn Mudrib, who said: “A letter from 'Umar was read out to us. We determined the obligation of board on the Ahl al-Dhimma for one day and night.
كتاب الأموال: 395 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّبٍ، قَالَ: قُرِئَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا الضِّيَافَةَ عَلَى أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً،

THE: If he (the guest) is delayed beyond that due to rain or illness, he has to spend his own wealth.”
كتاب الأموال: فَإِنْ حَبَسَهُ مَطَرٌ أَوْ مَرَضٌ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ مَالِهِ

THE: (398) He said: ‘Abd al-Wahhab ibn ‘Ata’ related to us from Hisham al-Dastwa’I from Qatada from al-Hasan from al-Ahnaf ibn Qays “that 'Umar imposed the condition of board and lodging of one day and night upon the Ahl al-Dhimma as well as the repair of bridges, and that if a Muslim was found dead in their area they would be held liable for the blood money (diya).”
كتاب الأموال: 396 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتُوَائِيِّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ اشْتَرَطَ الضِّيَافَةَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةَ، وَأَنْ يُصْلِحُوا الْقَنَاطِرَ، وَإِنْ قُتِلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِأَرْضِهِمْ فَعَلَيْهِمْ دِيَتُهُ

THE: (399) He said: Aba al-Yaman al-Himsi related to us from Abu Bakr ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Abi Maryam from Hakim ibn ‘Umayr, who said: “If a group (caravan) of Muslim migrants seeks shelter from a village of those who have concluded a peace agreement and they provide them this shelter, then the liability of the agreement is discharged from them.”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحِمْصِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «أَيُّمَا رُفْقَةٍ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ آوَاهُمُ اللَّيْلُ إِلَى أَهْلِ قَرْيَةٍ مِنَ الْمُعَاهَدِينَ، فَلَمْ يُؤْوُوهُمْ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُمُ الذِّمَّةِ»

THE: (400)  He said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim, who said: “Yazid ibn Sa‘id ibn Dhl ‘A§wOn related to us from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr ‘that ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab imposed a condition on the Nabateans of  Syria that the Muslims would have a right to their fruits and fodder, but they will not be permitted to load (and transport) these things’.”
كتاب الأموال: 398 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ ذِي عَصْوَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ اشْتَرَطَ عَلَى أَنْبَاطِ الشَّامِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ: أَنْ يُصِيبُوا مِنْ ثِمَارِهِمْ وَتِبْنِهِمْ وَلَا يَحْمِلُوا

THE: (402) He said: 'Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from al-Layth ibn Sa'd from Suhayl ibn 'Aqil“from 'Abd Allah ibn Hubayra al-Siba!, who said: “'Amr ibn al-'As made a peace settlement with the people of Antabulus, which lies in the area of Barqa between Africa and Egypt,,/ii for the payment of jizya stipulating that for making the payment they could sell any of their sons they liked.”
كتاب الأموال: 399 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ [ص:193] عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ السَّبَائِيِّ، قَالَ: صَالَحَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ أَهْلَ أَنْطَابُلْسَ، وَهِيَ مِنْ بِلَادِ بَرْقَةَ بَيْنَ إِفْرِيقِيَّةَ وَمِصْرَ عَلَى الْجِزْيَةِ، عَلَى أَنْ يَبِيعُوا مِنْ أَبْنَائِهِمْ مَا أَحَبُّوا فِي جِزْيَتِهِمْ

THE: (403) He said: Sa'id ibn Abi Maryam related to me from Ibn Lahl^ from Yazid ibn 'Abd Allah al-Hadrami that when he became the governor of Antabulus, Ibn Diyas came to him with their written agreement.
كتاب الأموال: 400 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، أَنَّهُ «أَتَاهُ ابْنُ دِيَاسٍ حِينَ وَلِيَ أَنْطَابُلْسَ بِكِتَابِ عَهْدِهِمْ»

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: Ibn Diyas was a Coptic Christian from among the Egyptian Nabateans.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: ابْنُ دِيَاسٍ: نَصْرَانِيُّ مِنْ أنْبَاطِ مِصْرَ قِبْطِيُّ

THE: (404) He said: <Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from 'Abd Allah ibn Lahl^ from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, who said: “There is no agreement or compact between the people of Egypt and the Blacks (of Africa).
كتاب الأموال: 401 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ: لَيْسَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ مِصْرَ وَبَيْنَ الْأَسَاوِدِ عَهْدٌ وَلَا مِيثَاقٌ،

THE: It was only a truce between us and them; we used to give them wheat and lentils, while they used to give us flour in return.
كتاب الأموال: إِنَّمَا هِيَ هُدْنَةٌ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ، نُعْطِيهِمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ قَمْحٍ وَعَدَسٍ، وَيُعْطُونَا دَقِيقًا،

THE: There was no restriction on buying their flour from them or from others.”
كتاب الأموال: وَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ نَشْتَرِيَ دَقِيقَهُمْ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: “Blacks” means the Nuba and others similar to them within the Sudan. The peace settlement was with the Nuba alone.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: الْأَسَاوِدُ وَالنُّوبَةُ وَمَا أَشْبَهَهَا مِنَ السُّودَانِ وَإِنَّمَا الصُّلْحُ لِلنُّوبَةِ خَاصَّةً

THE: (405) He said: 'Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from al-Layth ibn Sa'd, who said: “The peace settlement with the Nuba was that we will not fight with each other.
كتاب الأموال: 402 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ: إِنَّمَا الصُّلْحُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ النُّوبَةِ عَلَى أَنْ لَا نُقَاتِلَهُمْ وَلَا يُقَاتِلُونَا،

THE: They would give us flour and we would give them wheat. If they wished to sell their sons and women, then there was no restriction on the people for buying them.”
كتاب الأموال: وَأَنَّهُمْ يُعْطُونَنَا دَقِيقًا وَنُعْطِيهِمْ طَعَامًا، قَالَ: وَإِنْ بَاعُوا أَبْنَاءَهُمْ لَمْ أَرْ بَأْسًا عَلَى النَّاسِ أَنْ يَشْتَرُوا مِنْهُمْ

THE: (406) Al-Layth said: Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari did not see anything wrong with this. He said: “If the enemy, with whom a truce exists, sell their children there is no harm in buying them.”,s
كتاب الأموال: 403 - قَالَ اللَّيْثُ: وَكَانَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ لَا يَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا، قَالَ: وَمَنْ بَاعَ وَلَدَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ مِنَ الْعَدُوِّ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِاشْتِرَاءِ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ

THE: (407) Abu 'Ubayd said: Al-Awza'l had a similar opinion. He said: “There is nothing wrong with this, because our laws do not apply to them.”
كتاب الأموال: 404 - قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَكَذَلِكَ كَانَ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ: لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ، لِأَنَّ أَحْكَامَنَا لَا تَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ.

THE: (408) Sufyan and the jurists of Iraq used to consider this disapproved.
كتاب الأموال: 405 - وَأَمَّا سُفْيَانَ وَأَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ فَيَكْرَهُونَ ذَلِكَ.

THE: AbQ ‘Ubayd said: This is the preferred opinion, in my view, because an undertaking of security amounts to the granting of safe conduct, so how could they be enslaved?,/iii
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَهُوَ أَحَبُّ الْقَوْلَيْنِ إِلَيَّ؛ لِأَنَّ الْمُوَادَعَةَ أَمَانٌ، فَكَيْفَ يُسْتَرَقُّونَ؟

THE: (409) He said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim, who said: “JjJafwSn ibn ‘Amr and others related to us that Mu^wiya himself led the war against Cyprus, along with a number of Companions of the Messenger of God (pbuh).
كتاب الأموال: 406 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ " غَزَا قُبْرُسَ بِنَفْسِهِ، وَنَفَرَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،

THE: Among them were: Abu Dhar, Abu al-Darda\ Shadad ibn Aws and al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad. From among the Followers of the Companions were: KaQ) al-Ahbar and Jubayr ibn Nufayr.
كتاب الأموال: فِيهِمْ أَبُو ذَرٍّ، وَأَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ، وَشَدَّادُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ، وَالْمِقْدَادُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ، وَمِنَ التَّابِعِينَ كَعْبُ الْأَحْبَارِ، وَجُبَيْرُ بْنُ نُفَيْرٍ،

THE: He said, ‘He attacked them and God gave them a tremendous victory. They also came across a large booty.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: فَقَفَلَ مِنْهَا وَقَدْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ فَتْحًا عَظِيمًا،

THE: The Muslims continued to fight them till Mu^wiya made a permanent peace settlement with them during his rule.
كتاب الأموال: وَغَنَّمَهُمْ غَنَائِمَ كَثِيرَةً، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يَغْزُونَهُمْ حَتَّى صَالَحَهُمْ مُعَاوِيَةُ فِي وِلَايَتِهِ صُلْحًا دَائِمًا، عَلَى سَبْعَةِ آلَافِ دِينَارٍ، وَعَلَى النَّصِيحَةِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنْذَارِهِمْ مَسِيرَ عَدُوِّهِمْ مِنَ الرُّومِ إِلَيْهِمْ " هَذَا أَوْ نَحْوُهُ

THE: The conditions were that they would pay seven thousand dinars and keep the Muslims advised about the movements of their enemy, the Byzantines, towards the Muslims.” There were these conditions and others like them.’”

(410) He said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to me from Ism3‘il ibn Ayyash that Habib ibn Maslama al-Fihri made a peace settlement with the people of Jurzan and the land of Armenia” on the condition that they would provide the advancing armies with the lawful (halal) food of the Ahl al-Kitab.
كتاب الأموال: 407 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ، أَنَّ حَبِيبَ بْنَ مَسْلَمَةَ الْفِهْرِيَّ صَالَحَ أَهْلَ جُرْزَانَ وَبِلَادِ أَرْمِينِيَةَ عَلَى أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنْزَالَ الْجَيْشِ مِنْ حَلَالِ طَعَامِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ

THE: (411) He said: Muhammad ibn Rabl^ related to us from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Awn from Muhammad ibn Sirin that ‘Uthman made an agreement with the people in the area called Wara’ al-Nahr.
كتاب الأموال: 408 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ عَقَدَ لِمَنْ وَرَاءَ النَّهَرِ

THE: The Wealth of the Ahl al-Dhimma Permitted to the Muslims Over and Above the Terms of the Peace Settlement
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْ مَالِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فَوْقَ مَا صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ

THE: (412) He (AbQ ‘Ubayd) said: Abu Mu^wiya, Yahya ibn Sa‘id and Yazid ibn
كتاب الأموال: 409 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ

THE: 17 In fact, the better view is that of al-Layth and al-Awza!, because the cessation of hostilities between us and them does not make the Muslims liable for them, and their laws are not applicable to them. The acquisition of their children (as slaves) is by way of purchase and not by way of imprisonment. Therefore, it does not amount to a violation of the truce.
كتاب الأموال: سقطمنالنسخة

THE: 18 That is, if the people of the Island came to know about the movement of the Byzantine army towards the Muslims, it was incumbent upon them to warn the Muslims so that they would not be taken unawares.

19 It is stated in al-Munjad that this is the area comprising the plateaus and mountains of Asia Minor south of al-Qafqiz between the eastern plateau of Iran and Anidol on the west and between the sea of Qazwln and the banks of Upper Euphrates. Armenia comprises two territories: Turkey and Russia. Modern Armenia includes the Republic of Armenia and Azerbaijan.

iii It is difficult to agree with the editor here. What Aba <'Ubayd is saying is that the entry of the enemy, with whom a truce has been concluded, into Muslims’ lands amounts to granting them a visa (amJn), a guarantee of safe-conduct. This means respecting their original status in their own lands, which is freedom. A free person cannot be enslaved.
HarQn — all of them - related to us from WiqiP ibn lySs from Abd Zibyjtn, who said: “We said to SulaymSn, ‘What is permitted to us from (the wealth of) those who are within our dhimma (liability)?’
كتاب الأموال: هَارُونَ، كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ وِقَاءِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، قَالَ: قُلْنَا لِسَلْمَانَ: مَا يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنْ ذِمَّتِنَا؟

THE: He said: ‘Till you emerge from the darkness (blindness) into the light, and you move from poverty into sufficiency, and that you accompany him riding his animal without taking the direction he desires, and that you partake of his food and he partakes of yours.’”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: «مِنْ عَمَاكَ إِلَى هُدَاكَ، وَمِنْ فَقْرِكَ إِلَى غِنَاكَ، وَأَنْ تَصْحَبَ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ فَتَرْكَبَ دَابَّتَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَصْرِفَهُ عَنْ وَجْهٍ يُرِيدُهُ، وَأَنْ تَأْكُلَ طَعَامَهُ وَيَأْكُلَ طَعَامَكَ»

THE: (410) He said: Ishaq ibn ^sa related to us from Hammad ibn Salama from Abu dmran al-Jawni from Jundab ibn 'Abd Allah, who said: “We used to take some fruit and things'' from the Ahl al-Dhimma, but we did not take a share out of their women and wealth.
كتاب الأموال: 410 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: كُنَّا نُصِيبُ مِنْ ثِمَارِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ [ص:196] وَأَعْلَاقِهِمْ، وَلَا نُشَارِكُهُمْ فِي نِسَائِهِمْ وَأَمْوَالِهِمْ،

THE: We also used to take unpaid labour from them in the shape of guides to show the way”.
كتاب الأموال: وَكُنَّا نَتَسَخَّرُ الْعِلْجَ لِيَهْدِينَا الطَّرِيقَ

THE: (411) He said: Hisham ibn 'Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said: “'Umar employed unpaid labour from among the Nabateans of Palestine to clean the Bayt al-Maqdas. A huge quantity of rubbish had gathered inside it.”
كتاب الأموال: 411 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: تَسَخَّرَ عُمَرُ أَنْبَاطَ أَهْلِ فِلَسْطِينَ فِي كَنْسِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، وَكَانَتْ فِيهِ مَزْبَلَةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: The interpretation, in my view, of all these things that the Muslims used to acquire from the Ahl al-Dhimma is that these were stipulated for them along with the jizya when they made the peace settlement.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَإِنَّمَا وُجُوهُ هَذِهِ الْأَشْيَاءِ عِنْدِي الَّتِي كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يَأْخُذُونَ أَهْلَ الذِّمَّةِ بِهَا: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ شُرُوطًا عَلَيْهِمْ مُشْتَرَطَةً حِينَ صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهَا مَعَ الْجِزْيَةِ،

THE: This is the reason why the Muslims considered the acquisition of these things to be lawful, because they too used to stand by the liability they had assumed through the protection agreement. This is what is related from Shank and al-Hasan ibn Salih, and so also from Malik.
كتاب الأموال: فَكَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يَسْتَجِيزُونَ أَخْذَهُمْ بِهَا، إِذْ كَانَ يُوفِي لَهُمْ بِعَهْدِهِمْ وَذِمَّتِهِمْ هَكَذَا يُحْكَى عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، وَالْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ مَالِكٍ نَحْوٌ مِنْهُ.

THE: (412) He said: Ibn Bukayr related to me from him (Malik) that he was asked about the things that could be lawfully taken from the Ahl al-Dhimma, and he replied: “Nothing is to be taken from them, except what they give out of the goodness of their hearts.”
كتاب الأموال: 412 - قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْهُ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَمَّا يُنَالُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، قَالَ: لَا يُنَالُ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا بِطِيبِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ،

THE: It was said to him: “What about the hospitality that they were required to extend?”
كتاب الأموال: قِيلَ لَهُ فَالضِّيَافَةُ الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ؟

THE: He responded, “Even in this the burden was lightened for them (in the conditions).” A similar view is narrated from al-Awza'i.
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُخَفِّفُ عَنْهُمْ لَهَا وَقَدْ رُوِيَ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ نَحْوُ ذَلِكَ

THE: (414) He said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to me from al-Walid ibn Muslim, who said: “I asked al-Awza‘I about the fruit (crops) of the Ahl al-Dhimma. He said, ‘The Muslims used to take a very small quantity from their fruits. The fruit was, however, not given to the soldiers passing by.’”
كتاب الأموال: 413 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الْأَوْزَاعِيَّ عَنْ ثِمَارِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، فَقَالَ: «كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يُصِيبُونَ مِنْ ثِمَارِهِمُ الشَّيْءَ الْيَسِيرَ، مَا لَمْ يَمُرَّ بِهِمْ جَيْشٌ، فَلَا يَقُومُ ثِمَارُهُمْ لَهُ»

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: Al-Awza‘1 means by this that the Muslims used to take a very small quantity in accordance with what was stipulated and formed part of the peace settlement.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: يَعْنِي الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ أَنَّهُمْ إِنَّمَا كَانُوا يُصِيبُونَ ذَلِكَ الْيَسِيرَ، مِمَّا كَانَ [ص:197] اشْتُرِطَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَصُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ،

THE: We do not know of anyone, in the earliest period or in the more recent, who has granted permission for taking anything beyond this minimum. On this there are continuous narrations.
كتاب الأموال: فَأَمَّا زِيَادَةٌ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَمَا عَلِمْنَا أَحَدًا رَخَّصَ فِيهَا فِي قَدِيمَ الدَّهْرِ وَلَا حَدِيثَهُ وَفِي ذَلِكَ آثَارٌ مُتَوَاتِرَةٌ

THE: (415) He said: Sa‘id ibn Abi Maryam related to me from Yahya ibn AyyGb from 'Ubayd Allah ibn Zahar from ‘Ali ibn Yazid from al-Qasim - Abn ‘Abd al-Rahman - from Abu Amama from Ibn ‘Abbas that a man asked him a question saying: “When we pass by the (settlements) of the Ahl al-Dhimma, do we take a part of their barley or some other thing?”
كتاب الأموال: 414 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّا نَمُرُّ بِأَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، فَنُصِيبُ مِنَ الشَّعْرِ أَوِ الشَّيْءِ،

THE: He said: “It is not permitted to you to take on the basis of the dhimma (what they owe you), except what you have made them agree to.”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذِمَّتِكُمْ إِلَّا مَا صَالَحْتُمُوهُمْ عَلَيْهِ

THE: (416) He said: ‘Abd al-Rahm^n related to me from Sufyan from Abu Ishaq from Sa^a^, who said: “I asked Ibn ‘Abbas about our travelling through the land of the Ahl al-Dhimma and taking something from them.
كتاب الأموال: 415 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ صَعْصَعَةَ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقُلْتُ: إِنَّا نَسِيرُ فِي أَرْضِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فَنُصِيبُ مِنْهُمْ،

THE: He said, ‘Without paying a price?’ I said, ‘Without paying.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: بِغَيْرِ ثَمَنٍ؟ قُلْتُ بِغَيْرِ ثَمَنٍ،

THE: He said, ‘So what is your view about it?’ I said, ‘We believe it is lawful and there is nothing wrong in this.’
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ فَمَا تَقُولُونَ؟ قُلْتُ: نَقُولُ: حَلَالًا لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ،

THE: He said, ‘You say the same thing that the People of the Book used to say:
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: أَنْتُمْ تَقُولُونَ كَمَا قَالَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ: {لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ} [آل عمران: 75]

THE: There is no way over us as to the unlettered people; But they tell a lie against God, and (well) they know it.’”a/r
(417) He said: Abn Isma‘il related to us a similar, or almost similar, tradition from al-A‘mash from ‘Amr ibn Murra from AbU al-Bakhtari” from Ibn ‘Abbas.
كتاب الأموال: 416 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ نَحْوَهُ

THE: (418) He said: Al-Ashja'i and Ya'qdb al-Qari’ related to us from Malik ibn Mighwal from Talha ibn al-Mu$arrif,w who said: “Khalid ibn al-Walid said, ‘Do not take even three steps with the intention of assuming authority over three individuals, nor with the intention of retracting (the extent of a needle) from an agreement, nor with the intention of exposing the Muslim ruler to any danger (of insurrection).’”
كتاب الأموال: 417 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الْقَارِئُ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ الْمُصَرِّفِ، قَالَ: قَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ: «لَا تَمْشِ ثَلَاثَ خُطًى لِتَأَمَرَّ عَلَى [ص:198] ثَلَاثَةِ نَفَرٍ، وَلَا لِتَرْزَأَ مُعَاهِدًا إِبْرَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا، وَلَا لِتَبْغِيَ إِمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ غَائِلَةً»

THE: (419) He said: Ismail ibn Ibrahim related to us from Hajjaj ibn Abi 'Uthman from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, who said: “Abu 'Abd Allah, the client of Sa<d” - or he said “Abu 'Abd al-Rahman”, which Abu 'Ubayd doubted - “related to us saying, ‘I was with Sa'd when we had to spend the night in an orchard’” — in some traditions the words are “the orchard of a man from the Ahl al-Dhimma” — “‘and we asked for the owner, but did not find him.
كتاب الأموال: 418 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى سَعْدٍ، أَوْ قَالَ: أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - شَكَّ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ - قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ سَعْدٍ فَأجَنَّنَا اللَّيْلُ إِلَى حَائِطٍ - وَفِي غَيْرِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ إِلَى حَائِطِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ - فَطَلَبْنَا صَاحِبَهُ، فَلَمْ نَجِدْهُ،

THE: Sa'd said, “If you wish to meet God tomorrow as a Muslim, then do not consume anything from this orchard.” ’ He said, ‘We spent the night till morning without food.’”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: إِنْ سَرَّكَ أَنْ تَلْقَى اللَّهَ غَدًا مُسْلِمًا فَلَا تَرْزَأَنَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا قَالَ: فَبِتْنَا طَاوِيَيْنِ، حَتَّى أَصْبَحْنَا

THE: (420) He said: Hisham ibn 'Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said: “When Abd al-Darda used to camp in one of the villages, he did not benefit from it more than a drink of water and a rest under the shade.
كتاب الأموال: 419 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ يَنْزِلُ الْقَرْيَةَ مِنْ قُرَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، فَلَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى أَنْ يَشْرَبَ مِنْ مَائِهِمْ، وَيَسْتَظِلَّ بِظِلِّهِمْ،

THE: If his animals pastured on their lands, he directed his men to give them some thing or some coins.”
كتاب الأموال: وَتَرْعَى دَابَّتُهُ مِنْ مَرَاعِيهِمْ، فَيَأْمُرُ لَهُمْ بِالشَّيْءِ، أَوْ بِالْأَفْلُسِ

THE: (421) Al-Walid said: 'Uthman ibn Abi al-'Atika said that 'Ubada ibn al-Samit passed by a village called Dumarr within the territory of al-Ghuta and ordered his servant to cut him a siwdk (stick for brushing teeth) from a willow tree by the banks of the Bardi.
كتاب الأموال: 420 - قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي الْعَاتِكَةَ، أَنَّ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ مَرَّ بِقَرْيَةٍ يُقَالَ لَهَا: دَمَّرُ، مِنْ قُرَى الْغُوطَةِ، فَأَمَرَ غُلَامَهُ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ لَهُ سِوَاكًا مِنْ صَفْصَافٍ عَلَى نَهْرِ بَرَدَى،

THE: As the man started off, he called him back saying: “It does not have much value now, but on drying up it will turn into fuel with a value.”
كتاب الأموال: فَمَضَى لِيَفْعَلَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ: «ارْجِعْ فَإِنَّهُ إِلَّا يَكُنْ بِثَمَنٍ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَيْبُسُ، فَيَعُودُ حَطَبًا بِثَمَنٍ»

THE: (422) Al-Walid said: Al-Awza'i related to us that Abu Hurayra said to a soldier departing for the war front: “Do not step over crops, nor ascend a height without the permission of your commander, and beware do not take even a stack or two of fodder from the wealth of the Ahl al-Dhimma.
كتاب الأموال: 421 - قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ يُرِيدُ الْغَزْوَ [ص:199]: لَا تَطَأْ حَرْثًا وَلَا تَطْلُعْ شَرَفًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ إِمَامِكَ، وَإِيَّاكَ وَالْمِخْلَاةُ وَالْمِخْلَاتَيْنِ مِنْ أَمْوَالِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ،

THE: Only then can you say that you are soldier (in the cause of God).” The man then met Ibn 'Abbas and he gave him similar advice.
كتاب الأموال: ثُمَّ تَقُولُ: أَنَا غَازٍ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ لَقِيَ الرَّجُلُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ

THE: (423) He said: Yazid related to us from Waqa> ibn Iy3s from Aba Zibyln, who said: “We were with Salman (Farisi) at Jalala)S or Nahlwand when a man came to him who had loaded his animal with fruit and was offering it to anyone who passed by.
كتاب الأموال: 422 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، عَنْ وِقَاءِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَ سَلْمَانَ بِجَلُولَاءَ أَوْ نَهَاوَنْدَ، فَأَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ قَدْ أَوْقَرَ دَابَّتَهُ فَاكِهَةً يُطْعِمُ مَنْ مَرَّ بِهِ،

THE: Salman scolded him and he talked back at him. When he was told it was Salman he started apologizing to him.”
كتاب الأموال: فَسَبَّهُ سَلْمَانُ، فَسَبَّ سَلْمَانَ، فَقِيلَ لِلرَّجُلِ: هَذَا سَلْمَانُ، فَأَقْبَلَ يَعْتَذِرُ إِلَيْهِ

THE: (424) He said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to me from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Khalid ibn Yazid ibn Abi Malik from his father, who said: “The Muslims were at al-Jabiya and ‘Umar ibn al-Kha|tab was among them when a man from the Ahl al-Dhimma came to inform him that the people were taking away his grapes (from his vineyard).
كتاب الأموال: 423 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بِالْجَابِيَةِ، وَفِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ يُخْبِرُهُ: أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ أَسْرَعُوا فِي عِنَبِهِ

THE: ‘Umar went to out to the place where he found one of his own companions taking a shield full of grapes.
كتاب الأموال: فَخَرَجَ عُمَرُ حَتَّى لَقِيَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَحْمِلُ تُرْسًا عَلَيْهِ عِنَبٌ،

THE: ‘Umar said to him, ‘You too?’ He replied, ‘0 Commander of the Faithful, we were famished.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: «وَأَنْتَ أَيْضًا؟» فَقَالَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ

THE: ‘Umar went away and ordered that the owner of the vineyard be paid the value of his grapes.”
كتاب الأموال: فَانْصَرَفَ عُمَرُ فَأَمَرَ لِصَاحِبِ الْكَرْمِ بِقِيمَةِ عِنَبِهِ

THE: (425) He said: Abu al-Yaman related to us from Abu Bakr ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Abi Maryam from Hakim ibn ‘Umayr that ‘Umar declared his absolution from liability for the damage caused by the soldiers.
كتاب الأموال: 424 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ تَبَرَّأَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ مِنْ مَعَرَّةِ الْجَيْشِ

THE: Those Agreeing to a Peace Settlement are to be Allowed to Maintain Their Earlier Practices
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ يُتْرَكُونَ عَلَى مَا كَانُوا عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أُمُورِهِمْ

THE: (426)He (Aba °'Ubayd) said: Hisham ibn ‘Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim, who said: “Tamim ibn Attiyya related to me saying: ‘I heard ‘Abd Allah ibn Qays’ - or Ibn Abi Qays - ‘saying: “I was among those who met ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, along with Abu ‘Ubayda, when he arrived in Syria.
كتاب الأموال: 425 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي تَمِيمُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَوِ ابْنَ أَبِي قَيْسٍ يَقُولُ: كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ تَلَقَّى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ مَعَ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، مَقْدَمَهُ مِنَ الشَّامِ،

THE: ‘Umar was proceeding when some performers from Adhri^t started displaying their skills with swords and bouquets.
كتاب الأموال: فَبَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ يَسِيرُ إِذْ لَقِيَهُ الْمُقَلَّسُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَذْرِعَاتٍ بِالسُّيُوفِ وَالرَّيْحَانِ،

THE: ‘Umar said, ‘Stop them and send them away.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: مَهْ رُدُّوهُمْ وَامْنَعُوهُمْ،

THE: At this Abn 'Ubayda said, ‘O Commander of the Faithful, this the custom of the 'Ajam’ - or he said something similar.
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَذِهِ سُنَّةُ الْعَجَمِ، أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا،

THE: If you stop them from doing this they will think that you intend to take away something from their peace agreement.’ 'Umar said, ‘Let them be then, for 'Umar and his companions are under the authority of Aba 'Ubayda here.
كتاب الأموال: وَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَمْنَعْهُمْ مِنْهَا يَرَوْا أَنَّ فِي نفْسِكَ نَقْضًا لِعَهْدِهِمْ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: دَعُوهُمْ، عُمَرُ وَآلُ عُمَرَ فِي طَاعَةِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ

THE: ”””Aba 'Ubayda said: Al-MiqlSsOn are people who perform before eminent persons in order to welcome them. 'Umar rejected their activity and disapproved of it, but then accepted it, because it was their practice prior to the peace agreement.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: الْمُقَلَّسُونَ قَوْمٌ يَلْعَبُونَ بِلُعْبَةٍ لَهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِي الْأُمَرَاءِ إِذَا قَدِمُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَنْكَرَهَا عُمَرُ وَكَرِههَا ثُمَّ أَقَرَّهَا، لِأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ مُتَقَدِّمَةً لَهُمْ قَبْلَ الصُّلْحِ،

THE: Likewise, all that constituted their practice including their synagogues and churches as well as other things. The peace agreement had included all this, and no one had the right to violate it.
كتاب الأموال: وَكَذَلِكَ كُلُّ مَا كَانَ مِنْ سُنَّتِهِمْ وَبِيَعِهِمْ وَكَنَائِسِهِمْ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ،
فَوَقَعَ الصُّلْحُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ نَقَضَهُ

THE: This is the interpretation of Ibn <Abbas’s opinion, which we mentioned, and he said: “Regarding the things that exist from before, the Muslims are under a duty to abide by their agreement with them.” He said: For such views there are traditions.
كتاب الأموال: وَهُوَ تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ الَّذِي ذَكَرْنَاهُ، قَوْلُهُ: وَمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَحَقٌّ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ أَنْ يُوَفُّوا لَهُمْ بِهِ، قَالَ: وَفِي مِثْلِ هَذَا أَحَادِيثُ

THE: (428) Nu^ym ibn Hammad related to me from Damra ibn Rabi'a from Raja ibn Abi Salama, who said: “Hassan ibn Malik brought a dispute with the 'Ajam of Damascus over a church before 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz claiming that so-and-so” - and he named one of the officials - “granted it to him as an estate.
كتاب الأموال: 426 - حَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ رَجَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: خَاصَمَ حَسَّانُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَجَمَ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي كَنِيسَةٍ، وَكَانَ فُلَانٌ سَمَّى رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأُمَرَاءِ أَقْطَعَهُ إِيَّاهَا،

THE: 'Umar said to him, ‘If it is one of the fifteen churches included in their peace agreement, there is no way you can get it.”’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «إِنْ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْخَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ كَنِيسَةً الَّتِي فِي عَهْدِهِمْ فَلَا سَبِيلَ لَكَ إِلَيْهَا»

THE: (429) Damra related from 'Ali ibn Hamala, who said: “We brought a dispute with the 'Ajam of Damascus over a church before 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz maintaining that so-and-so had granted it as an estate to the Bana Nasr of Damascus.
كتاب الأموال: 427 - وَقَالَ ضَمْرَةُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمَلَةَ، قَالَ: خَاصَمْنَا عَجَمَ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي كَنِيسَةٍ، كَانَ فُلَانٌ قَطَعَهَا لِبَنِي نَصْرٍ بِدِمَشْقَ،

THE: 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz evicted us from there and gave it back to the Christians. When Yazid ibn 'Abd al-Malik assumed power, he returned it to the Banu Nasr evicting the Christians.”
كتاب الأموال: فَأَخْرَجَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ مِنْهَا وَرَدَّهَا إِلَى النَّصَارَى، فَلَمَّا وَلِيَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ رَدَّهَا عَلَى بَنِي نَصْرٍ، وَأَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا النَّصَارَى

THE: (430) He said: Damra related from Raja - Aba Salama’s client — from al-Walid ibn Hisham al-Mu<aytI, who said: “When 'Umar ibn <Abd al-'Aziz appointed me governor of Qansarln, which was annexed peacefully, the Ahl al-Dhimma complained to him that the Muslims had occupied their residences.
كتاب الأموال: 428 - قَالَ: وَقَالَ ضَمْرَةُ، عَنْ رَجَاءٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ الْمُعَيْطِيِّ، قَالَ: وَلَّانِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قِنَّسْرِينَ وَكَانَتْ صُلْحًا فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ أَهْلُ الذِّمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ نَزَلُوا مَنَازِلَهُمْ،

THE: He wrote to me directing that I investigate as to who had occupied the residences of those who were part of the peace agreement and that I evict those who had occupied the houses. He said, ‘I investigated the matter and found them to be few.
كتاب الأموال: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ: أَنِ انْظُرْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي مَنَازِلِ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا حِينَ صُولِحُوا، فَأَخْرِجْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ عَنْهَا، قَالَ: فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا أُولَئِكَ قَلِيلٌ

THE: They (the Ahl Dhimma) asked me to refrain from taking action and I did so.’”
كتاب الأموال: فَسَأَلُونِي الْكَفَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَكَفَفْتُ

THE: Aba 'Ubayda said: 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz gave these decisions regarding their churches and houses because these were their private and religious rights
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: إِنَّمَا حَكَمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بِكَنَائِسِهِمْ وَمَنَازِلِهِمْ لَهُمْ، لِأَنَّهَا مِنْ حُقُوقِهِمْ وَدِينِهِمْ مَعَ الصُّلْحِ، وَلَوْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ مَا دَخَلَ فِي الصُّلْحِ، وَكَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَوْلَى بِهِ، مِثْلُ الَّذِي فَعَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بِمَسْجِدِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ،

THE: as included in the peace agreement. Had there been a right of the Muslims attached to them, they would not have formed part of the agreement, and the Muslims would have had a prior right to them, as in the case of the mosque at Bayt al-Maqdas.
These lands had been annexed peacefully, but he took from the Ahl al-Dhimma and gave to the Muslims. He did not recognize their right in it.
كتاب الأموال: وَإِنَّمَا افْتَتَحَ الْبِلَادَ صُلْحًا، ثُمَّ حَالَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَبَيْنَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَلَمْ يَرَ لَهُمْ فِيهِ حَقًّا

THE: (431) He said: 'Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from al-Layth ibn Sa<d from Yazid ibn Abi Habib that 'Umar ibn al-Khattab sent Khalid ibn Thabit al-Fahmi to the Bayt al-Maqdas with an army, while 'Umar himself stayed at al-Jabiya.
كتاب الأموال: 429 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ بَعَثَ خَالِدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ الْفَهْمِيَّ إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ [ص:202] فِي جَيْشٍ، وَعُمَرُ بِالْجَابِيَةِ،

THE: He said: “They fought with them and they agreed to surrender on the condition that the inner part of the fort would belong to them in return for some amount they will continue to pay, while the Muslims would have what was outside.
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: فَقَاتَلَهُمْ فَأَعْطَوْهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمْ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ حِصْنُهَا، عَلَى شَيْءٍ يُؤَدُّونَهُ، وَيَكُونُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ مَا كَانَ خَارِجًا مِنْهَا،

THE: Khalid said to them, ‘We agree to the terms subject to ratification by the Commander of the Faithful.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ خَالِدٌ: قَدْ بَايَعْنَاكُمْ عَلَى هَذَا، إِنْ رَضِيَ بِهِ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ،

THE: He then wrote to 'Umar informing him of the situation in which God had placed him.
كتاب الأموال: وَكَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ يُخْبِرُهُ بِالَّذِي صَنَعَ اللَّهُ لَهُ،

THE: He wrote back saying, ‘Maintain your position till I come to you.’
كتاب الأموال: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ: «أَنْ قِفْ عَلَى حَالِكَ حَتَّى أَقْدَمَ عَلَيْكَ» ،

THE: Khalid halted the attack till 'Umar arrived. They opened the Bayt al-Maqdas for him on the terms that had been concluded by Khalid ibn Thabit.
كتاب الأموال: فَوَقَفَ خَالِدٌ عَنْ قِتَالِهِمْ، وَقَدِمَ عُمَرُ مَكَانَهُ فَفَتَحُوا لَهُ بَيْتَ الْمَقْدِسِ عَلَى مَا بَايَعَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ خَالِدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ،

THE: He said, ‘It was thus that Bayt al-Maqdas was called the Conquest of 'Umar ibn al-Khattab.’”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: فَبَيْتُ الْمَقْدِسِ يُسَمَّى فَتْحُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ

THE: (432) He said: Hisham ibn 'Ammar related to him from al-Haytham ibn SAmmar al-'Ansl, who said: “I hear my grandfather, 'Abd Allah ibn Abi 'Abd Allah, saying: ‘When 'Umar assumed authority he paid a visit to the People of Syria.

كتاب الأموال: 430 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ الْعَنْسِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَدِّي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ: لَمَّا وَلِيَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ زَارَ أَهْلَ الشَّامِ،

THE: He came to al-Jabiya and sent a man from Jadila to Bayt al-Maqdas. He annexed it peacefully.
كتاب الأموال: فَنَزَلَ الْجَابِيَةَ، وَأَرْسَلَ رَجُلًا مِنْ جَدِيلَةَ إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، فَافْتَتَحَهَا صُلْحًا،

THE: 'Umar then followed and with him was KaT). He said, “0 Abu Ishaq, do you know the location of the Rock?”
كتاب الأموال: ثُمَّ جَاءَ عُمَرُ وَمَعَهُ كَعْبٌ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، أَتَعْرِفُ مَوْضِعَ الصَّخْرَةِ؟

THE: He replied, “Measure from the wall next to the Wadi Jahannam so many armslengths, and then dig at the spot and you will find it.”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ أَذْرُعٌ مِنَ الْحَائِطِ الَّذِي يَلِي وَادِي جَهَنَّمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ذِرَاعًا، ثُمَّ احْتَفِرْ [ص:203]، فَإِنَّكَ تَجِدُهَا،

THE: The place was in those days a dunghill. They dug there and it appeared. 'Umar said to Ka<b, “Where do you think the mosque
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: وَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مَزْبَلَةٌ فَحَفَرُوا فَظَهَرَتْ لَهُمْ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِكَعْبٍ: أَيْنَ تَرَى أَنْ نَجْعَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ؟ - أَوْ قَالَ: الْقِبْلَةَ –

THE: should be located?” - or he said “the qibla”.
He said, “Build it just behind the Rock, so that it covers two qiblas - that of Moses, peace be on him, and that of Muhammad (pbuh).”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: اجْعَلْهَا خَلْفَ الصَّخْرَةِ، فَتَجْمَعُ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ: قِبْلَةَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَقِبَلَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،

THE: <'Umar said, “O Abu Ishaq, you are imitating Jewish structures. The best part of a mosque is its front.” He said that he had it (the qibla) located in the front part of the Mosque.’”
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: ضَاهَيْتَ الْيَهُودِيَّةَ يَا أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، خَيْرُ الْمَسَاجِدِ مُقَدَّمُهَا قَالَ: فَبَنَاهَا فِي مُقَدَّمِ الْمَسْجِدِ

THE: (434) He said: Hisham related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said: “'Umar ibn al-Khattab made use (without compensation) of the Nabateans of Palestine for sweeping the Bayt al-Maqdas and there was a huge quantity of filth there.”
كتاب الأموال: 431 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: تَسَخَّرَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَنْبَاطَ أَهْلِ فِلَسْطِينَ فِي كَنْسِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، وَكَانَتْ فِيهِ مَزْبَلَةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: You should notice that 'Umar took possession of the Mosque for the Muslims and took away the rights of the Ahl al-Dhimma to it.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: أَفَلَسْتَ تَرَى أَنَّ عُمَرَ حَازَ الْمَسْجِدَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَحَالَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَبَيْنَهُ،

THE: They do not enter it to this day. 'Umar did not declare the Mosque to be a part of the agreement, because their rights were not attached to it.
كتاب الأموال: فَهُمْ عَلَى هَذَا إِلَى الْيَوْمِ لَا يُدْخِلُونَهُ، وَإِنَّمَا كَانَتِ الْبِلَادُ صُلْحًا، فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ عُمَرُ الْمَسْجِدَ دَاخِلًا فِي الصُّلْحِ، لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ حُقُوقِهِمْ

THE: The Status of the Land of Dhimmis Embracing Islam:
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ كَيْفَ تَكُونُ أَرْضُهُ، أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ أَمْ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؟

THE: Is it KharZj Land or 'Ushr Land?
(435) Aba 'Ubayd related to us saying: Yazid ibn HarQn related to us from Ibn Abi Dhi’b from al-Zuhri, who said: “The Messenger of God (pbuh) accepted jizya from the Magians of Bahrayn.”
كتاب الأموال: 432 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: «قَبِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجِزْيَةَ مِنْ مَجُوسِ الْبَحْرَيْنِ»

THE: Al-Zuhri said: “Those among them who embraced Islam received protection of their persons and wealth because of their Islam, except for their land which was fay* (common booty) for the Muslims, because the owner did not embrace Islam the first time when he had the choice.”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ قَبِلَ إِسْلَامَهُ، وَأَحْرَزَ إِسْلَامُهُ نَفْسَهُ وَمَالَهُ، إِلَّا الْأَرْضَ فَإِنَّهَا فَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُسْلِمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ فِي مَنَعَةٍ

THE: (436) Sa'id ibn 'Ufayr related a similar tradition to me from Yahya ibn Ayyub from Yunus ibn Yazid from Ibn Shihab.
كتاب الأموال: 433 - وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ [ص:204]

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: He does not mean by his statement “which was fay* for the Muslims” that it was taken away from him on embracing Islam.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: لَيْسَ يُرِيدُ بِقَوْلِهِ: إِنَّ أَرْضَهُ، فَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، أَنَّهَا تُنْزَعُ مِنْهُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ،

THE: He means that it was retained as kharaj land as before, because it was fay* for the Muslims and could not be treated as <ushr land of the Muslims who owned it.
كتاب الأموال: وَلَكِنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنَّهَا تَكُونُ أَرْضَ خَرَاجٍ عَلَى حَالِهَا، لِأَنَّهَا فَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلَا يَرْضَى مِنْهُ بِالْعُشْرِ كَأَرْضِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الَّتِي يَمْلِكُونَهَا،

THE: This is in accordance with the opinion of those who disapproved the purchase of the land of those under peace agreements.Something is related from 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz that relies on this rule.
كتاب الأموال: وَهَذَا مَذْهَبُ مَنْ كَرِهَ شِرَاءَ أَرْضِ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ، وَقَدْ رُوِيَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ شَيْءٌ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى هَذَا

THE: (437) He said: 'Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from al-Layth ibn Sa'd that 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz said: “If any person from a nation that has made a peace agreement on the basis of the payment of jizya embraces Islam his land belongs to the rest of them (his nation).”
كتاب الأموال: 434 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ: أَيُّمَا قَوْمٍ صُولِحُوا عَلَى جِزْيَةٍ يُعْطُونَهَا، فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ كَانَتْ أَرْضُهُ لِبَقِيَّتِهِمْ قَالَ

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: This means that the rules for his land are the same as the rules applied to them, and its payment will be made according to the rules for their payment.
كتاب الأموال: أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: يَقُولُ: تَكُونُ سُنَّتُهُ كَسُنَّتِهِمْ، وَحُكْمُهُ فِي الْأَدَاءَ عَنْهَا كَحُكْمِهِمْ، وَكَانَ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ يَقُولُ غَيْرَ هَذَا

THE: Malik ibn Anas used to hold a different opinion.
(439) He said: Yahya ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr related to me from Malik, who said: “If a person from among those making a peace agreement embraces Islam, he has a right to his land.
كتاب الأموال: 435 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، أَمَّا أَهْلُ الصُّلْحِ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِأَرْضِهِ،

THE: As compared to this, the wealth of those who are subjugated by force of arms belongs to the Muslims, because they were defeated in their land, and the land became booty for the Muslims.
كتاب الأموال: وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الْعَنْوَةِ فَإِنَّ أَرْضَهُمْ وَمَالَهُمْ [ص:205] لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ؛ لِأَنَّ أَهْلَ الْعَنْوَةِ قَدْ غُلِبُوا عَلَى بِلَادِهِمْ، وَصَارَتْ فَيْئًا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ،

THE: Those making a peace agreement, on the other hand, defended themselves and their land till such time that peace was concluded. For them the conditions are what they agreed to.”
كتاب الأموال: وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الصُّلْحِ فَإِنَّهُمْ مَنَعُوا بِلَادَهُمْ وَأَنْفُسَهُمْ حَتَّى صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِا، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا مَا صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ.

THE: Abu HJbayd said: Ash^t has related something from Ibn Sirin that resembles this.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَقَدْ رَوَى أَشْعَثُ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ شَيْئًا يُشْبِهُ هَذَا

THE: (440) He said: Jarir related to us from Ash<at from Ibn Sirin, who said: “Part of the Sawad was conquered by the force of arms and part of it was annexed peacefully.
كتاب الأموال: 436 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: «مِنَ السَّوَادِ مَا أُخِذَ عَنْوَةً وَمِنْهُ كَانَ صُلْحًا،

THE: What was annexed peacefully belongs to them, while that conquered by force of arms belongs to the Muslims.”
كتاب الأموال: فَمَا كَانَ صُلْحًا فَهُوَ مَالُهُمْ، وَمَا كَانَ عَنْوَةً فَهُوَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ»

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: The interpretation of the views of Ibn Sirin and Malik give the meaning that there is nothing unlawful in the purchase of the land covered by peace agreements, because it belongs to them.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: فَعَلَى تَأْوِيلِ مَذْهَبِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ وَمَالِكٍ: أَنَّهُ لَا بَأْسَ بِشِرَى أَرْضِ الصُّلْحِ، لِأَنَّهُ مِلْكُهُمْ.

THE: (441) He said: This is also related from al-Hasan ibn Salih. He did not see any harm in the purchase (from the owner) of land annexed peacefully, but he disapproved the purchase of land conquered by the force of arms.
كتاب الأموال: 437 - قَالَ: وَكَذَا يُرْوَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا، وَيَكْرَهُ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْعَنْوَةِ.

THE: AbU 'Ubayd said: It follows from this opinion that if they (the owners) embrace Islam their land is converted to '•ushr land because it is lawfully owned by them.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَيَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي هَذَا الْمَذْهَبِ أَيْضًا: أَنَّهُمْ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا صَارَتْ أَرْضُوهُمْ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهَا مِلْكُ أَيْمَانِهِمْ وَأَمَّا الَّذِي يَقُولُ بِهِ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ فَغَيْرُ هَذَا.

THE: Abu Hani fa’s opinion is different from this.
(442) Muhammad reported to me from him that he used to say: “If a person from among those who concluded a peace agreement embraces Islam or his land
كتاب الأموال: 438 - أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْهُ مُحَمَّدٌ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ، أَوِ اشْتَرَى أَرْضَهُ مُسْلِمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ، فَإِنَّ الصُّلْحَ بَاقٍ عَلَى حَالِهِ.

THE: is bought by a Muslim, the terms of the peace agreement will continue to operate as before (for this land)."
(443) Abu 'Ubayd said: The opinion that I prefer is this: When they embrace Islam, all the rules applicable to them are changed to those applicable to Muslims.
كتاب الأموال: 439 - قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَأَمَّا الَّذِي أَخْتَارُ أَنَا فَذَاكَ الْقَوْلُ، أَنَّهُمْ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا كُلُّهُمْ رُدَّتْ أَحْكَامُهُمْ إِلَى أَحْكَامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ،

THE: Thus, their land becomes ^iishr land, because of the stipulation by the Messenger of God (pbuh) and his promise: “Whoever accepts Islam will have the rights of Muslims and will owe the duties owed by Muslims, for Islam demolishes what was practised before.”
كتاب الأموال: فَكَانَتْ أَرَضُوهُمْ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهُ شَرْطُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَهْدِهِ: أَنَّهُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَلَهُ مَا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَلَيْهِ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَإِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ يَهْدِمُ مَا كَانَ قَبْلَهُ

THE: You know that when they embrace Islam the drinking of wine and other things is forbidden to them.
كتاب الأموال: أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّهُ يُحَالُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ وَغَيْرِ [ص:206] ذَلِكَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا،

THE: The same is the case with their land. Khardj is to be imposed on them as long as they belong to the Ahl al-Dhimma.
كتاب الأموال: فَكَذَلِكَ بِلَادُهُمْ إِنَّمَا يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَرَاجُ مَا كَانُوا أَهْلَ ذِمَّةٍ

THE: As soon as they become Muslims they are liable to the duty imposed by God with respect to the payment of zakat. They are now like all the other Muslims.
كتاب الأموال: فَإِذَا أَسْلَمُوا وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَرْضُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي الزَّكَاةِ وَكَانُوا كَسَائِرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

THE: Peace Agreements and Truce Between the Muslims
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ الصُّلْحِ وَالْمُهَادَنَةِ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ إِلَى مُدَّةٍ

THE: and the Polytheists are Temporary
(444) He (Abu 'Ubayd) said: 'Uthman ibn Salih related to us from Ibn Lahl'a from Abu al-Aswad from 'Urwa; and
كتاب الأموال: 440 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ. وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، 441 - أَنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَمَّا بَايَعُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى بَيْعَةِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ رَغِبَتْ تِلْكَ الْبَيْعَةَ مَنْ كَانُوا ارْتَهَنُوا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، ثُمَّ دَعُوا إِلَى الْمُوَادَعَةِ وَالصُّلْحِ

THE: Hisham ibn 'Ammar related to us from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Ibn Lahl'a from Aba al-Aswad from 'Urwa that when the Muslims gave their allegiance to the Messenger of God (pbuh) through the oath of Hudaybiyya, the oath-taking prompted the hostage polytheists to call for peace and cessation of hostilities.
It was then that God sent down the verse:
كتاب الأموال: فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: {وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْ [ص:207] بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا} [الفتح: 24]

THE: And it is He who has restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makka, after that He gave you victory over them. And God sees well all that ye do.”
'Urwa said: The Exalted then mentioned fighting:
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ عُرْوَةُ: ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى الْقِتَالَ، فَقَالَ: {وَلَوْ قَاتِلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا} [الفتح: 22]

THE: If the unbelievers should fight you, they would certainly turn their backs; then they would find neither protector nor helper.

The Quraysh agreed with the Messenger of God (pbuh) to a cessation of hostilities and made a peace agreement with him for a period of four years stipulating that they would be safe from each other (against attack or aggression); that they would not misappropriate each other’s wealth nor raid each other; that anyone (a Muslim) arriving to perform the pilgrimage or to perform the ^umra (visit) or proceeding to Yemen or Ta’if would be safe; and that any polytheist going to Madina with an intention to go to Syria or eastward would be safe.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: فَهَادَنَتْ قُرَيْشٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَصَالَحَتْهُ عَلَى سِنِينَ أَرْبَعٍ، أَنْ يَأْمَنَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا، عَلَى أَلَّا إِغْلَالَ وَلَا إِسْلَالَ، فَمَنْ قَدِمَ حَاجًّا، أَوْ مُعْتَمِرًا، أَوْ مُجْتَازًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ أَوْ إِلَى الطَّائِفِ، فَهُوَ آمِنٌ، وَمَنْ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ عَامِدًا إِلَى الشَّامِ أَوْ إِلَى الْمَشْرِقِ، فَهُوَ آمِنٌ،

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) had associated his allies Banu Ka<b in the agreement, while the Quraysh had associated their allies, the Banu Kinana.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: وَأَدْخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي عَهْدِهِ بَنِي كَعْبٍ، وَأَدْخَلَتْ قُرَيْشٌ فِي عَهْدِهَا حُلَفَاءَهَا بَنِي كِنَانَةَ:

THE: A final clause was that anyone from the Quraysh (or their allies) who came to Madina with the intention of becoming a Muslim would be sent back, while any Muslim going over to the Quraysh would not be sent back.
كتاب الأموال: وَعَلَى أَنَّهُ مَنْ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُسْلِمًا رَدَّهُ إِلَيْهِمْ، وَمَنْ أَتَاهُمْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَمْ يَرُدُّوهُ إِلَيْهِ

THE: (446) Yazid related to us from Muhammad ibn Ishaq from al-Zuhri from 'Urwa from al-Miswar ibn Makhrama and Marwan ibn al-Hakam, and both said: “A condition included in the agreement, on the day of Hudaybiyya, between the Messenger of God (pbuh) and the Quraysh was that he would return this year
كتاب الأموال: 442 - وَحَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَا: كَانَ مِنْ شَرْطِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قُرَيْشٍ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَنْ «تَرْجِعَ عَامَكَ هَذَا، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ عَامَ قَابِلٍ دَخَلْتَ [ص:208] مَكَّةَ وَمَعَكَ مِثْلَ سِلَاحِ الرَّاكِبِ، لَا تَدْخُلْهَا إِلَّا بِالسُّيُوفِ فِي الْقِرَبِ، فَتُقِيمُ بِهَا ثَلَاثًا»

THE: and in the next year he would enter Makka with only those arms that are necessary for a traveller with the swords in their sheaths, and that then he would stay for three days.”

(447) He said: IsmS‘11 ibn Ja'far related to us from Isr3‘ll from Aba Ishaq from al-Barra ibn ‘Azib, who said: “The Messenger of God (pbuh) resolved to perform the <-umra during the month of Dhu al-Qa‘da, but the residents of Makka did not let him enter it.
كتاب الأموال: 443 - قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ: اعْتَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، فَأَبَى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يَدْعُوهَ يَدْخُلُ مَكَّةَ،

THE: He then made an agreement with them containing the stipulation that he would not stay more than three days and that he would not carry any weapon except a sheathed sword.
كتاب الأموال: حَتَّى قَاضَاهُمْ عَلَى أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِهَا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، وَلَا يَدْخُلُهَا بِسِلَاحٍ إِلَّا بِالسَّيْفِ فِي الْقِرَابِ،

THE: An instrument was recorded for this agreement, and ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib wrote as follows: ‘This is the agreement concluded by Muhammad the Messenger of God (pbuh).’
كتاب الأموال: فَلَمَّا كَتَبَ الْكِتَابَ كَتَبَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

THE: They (the Quraysh) said, ‘We do not acknowledge this. If we recognized you as the Messenger of God, we would not have stopped you, but you are Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالُوا: لَا نُقِرُّ بِهَذَا، لَوْ عَلِمْنَا أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مَا مَنَعْنَاكَ، وَلَكِنْ أَنْتَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،

THE: He said, ‘Yes, I am Ibn ‘Abd Allah, and I am the Messenger of God.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: وَأَنَا ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،

THE: He then said to ‘Ali, ‘Erase the words Messenger of God.’ 'Ali said, ‘I will not erase them, ever.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ: امْحُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ: لَا أَمْحُوهُ أَبَدًا

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) took the parchment, and though he could not write in a good hand, he wrote, ‘This is what Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah has agreed to with the people of Makka: that he will not enter Makka except with his sword in its sheath; that he will not take away anyone from there who wishes to follow him; and that he will not prevent anyone out of his Companions who wishes to stay there.’
كتاب الأموال: فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْكِتَابَ، وَلَيْسَ يُحْسِنُ يَكْتُبُ، فَكَتَبَ: هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ: عَلَى أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَ مَكَّةَ بِسِلَاحٍ إِلَّا السَّيْفُ فِي الْقِرَابِ، وَأَنْ لَا يَخْرُجَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا بِأَحَدٍ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَّبِعَهُ، وَلَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِهَا

THE: When the time was over they came up to ‘Ali and said, ‘Tell your companion to leave us now for the time is over.’ The Messenger of God (pbuh) then departed.”M
كتاب الأموال: فَلَمَّا دَخَلَهَا وَمَضَى الْأَجَلُ أَتَوْا عَلَيًا، فَقَالُوا [ص:209]: قُلْ لِصَاحِبِكَ فَلْيَخْرُجْ عَنَّا، فَقَدْ مَضَى الْأَجَلُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

THE: (448) ‘Abd al-Rahm^n ibn Mahdi and ‘Umar ibn Ynnus al-YamSmi related to us from Tkrima ibn (Ammar saying: “Abu Zumayl related to us saying: ‘Ibn ‘Abbas related to us that when al-HarQriya revolted he went out to them for a dialogue.
كتاب الأموال: 444 - قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ الْيَمَامِيُّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: لَمَّا خَرَجَتِ الْحَرُورِيَّةُ أَتَاهُمُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لِيُحَاجَّهُمْ،

THE: One of the arguments they gave was that “Your companion himself erased (gave up the use of) the title ‘Commander of the Faithful’ for himself.”
كتاب الأموال: فَكَانَ فِيمَا احْتَجُّوا بِهِ أَنْ قَالُوا: إِنَّ صَاحِبَكَ مَحَا نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

THE: Ibn ‘Abbas said, “When the Messenger of God (pbuh) made a peace settlement with the polytheists on the day of Hudaybiyya, he said, ‘Write O ‘Ali. This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of God, has agreed upon.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ صَالَحَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَقَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ اكْتُبْ يَا عَلِيُّ: هَذَا مَا صَالَحَ عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

THE: At this
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالُوا: لَا نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَلَوْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مَا مَنَعْنَاكَ - أَوْ قَالَ: مَا قَاتَلْنَاكَ –

THE: they said, ‘We do not recognize you as the Messenger of God. Had we recognized you as the Messenger of God, we would not have stopped you’ - or they said, ‘we would not have fought with you?
The Messenger of God (pbuh) said, ‘Erase it O 'Ali. O Lord, You know that I am Your Messenger. Write: This is what is agreed upon by Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: امْحُ يَا عَلِيُّ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي رَسُولُكَ اكْتُبْ هَذَا مَا صَالَحَ عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

THE: This was the case when the Messenger of God (pbuh) had a higher status than 'Ali. Have I made my point?” They said, “Yes.”
كتاب الأموال: فَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْرَجْتُ مِنْ هَذِهِ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ.

THE: ’” He then went on to narrate a very lengthy tradition.
كتاب الأموال: ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ حَدِيثًا طَوِيلًا [ص:210]

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: Cessation of hostilities between the Muslims and the polytheists takes place if the commander is apprehensive that they will overpower the Muslims, or when he is not completely satisfied about their weakness, or when he is doing so by way of a stratagem.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: إِنَّمَا تَكُونُ الْمُوَادَعَةُ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ إِذَا خَافَ الْإِمَامُ غَلَبَةً مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلَمْ يَأْمَنْ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ أَنْ يَضْعُفُوا، أَوْ أَنْ يَكُونَ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ كَيْدًا،

THE: If none of these reasons is found, he cannot do so. This is because God, the Exalted, has said:
كتاب الأموال: فَأَمَّا إِذَا لَمْ يَخْفَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَا وَذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَقُولُ: {فَلَا تَهِنُوا وَتَدْعُوا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ} [محمد: 35]

THE: Be not weary and faint-hearted, crying for peace, when ye are the uppermost for God is with you and will never put you in loss for your (good) deeds.”"
Likewise, if he fears that the enemy will overpower the Muslims, and the payment of some wealth will keep them away from the Muslims, he may. do so.
كتاب الأموال: وَكَذَلِكَ لَوْ خَافَ مِنَ الْعَدُوِّ اسْتِعْلَاءً عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَاحْتَاجَ إِلَى أَنْ يَتَّقِيهِمْ بِمَالٍ يَدْرَؤُهُمْ بِهِ عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ،

THE: This is what the Messenger of God (pbuh) had prepared to do during the Battle of the Trenches (al-Ahzab). The ruler is the protector of the Muslims.
كتاب الأموال: كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ إِنَّمَا الْإِمَامُ نَاظِرٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ

THE: (449) <Abd Allah ibn Salih related to us from al-Layth ibn Sa<d from 'Uqayl ibn Khalid from Ibn Shihab, who said: “The Battle of Ahzab took place two years after Uhud.
كتاب الأموال: 445 - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُقَيْلِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: كَانَتْ وَقْعَةُ الْأَحْزَابِ بَعْدَ أُحُدٍ بِسَنَتَيْنٍ،

THE: This was the year when the Messenger of God (pbuh) dug trenches' and the leader of the unbelievers was Abn Sufyan ibn al-Harb.
كتاب الأموال: وَذَلِكَ يَوْمَ حَفَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْخَنْدَقَ، وَرَئِيسُ الْكُفَّارِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ

THE: They laid siege to the positions of the Messenger of God (pbuh) for more than ten nights, and the Muslims underwent considerable suffering.
كتاب الأموال: فَحَاصَرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً فَخَلَصَ إِلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْكَرْبُ،

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) said - as conveyed to me by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab - ‘O Lord, I recall Your covenant and Your promise.
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ - كَمَا أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَنْشُدُكَ عَهْدَكَ وَوَعْدَكَ،

THE: If You wish You shall not be worshipped.’
كتاب الأموال: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ تَشَأْ [ص:211] لَا تُعْبَدُ»

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) went so far as to send his messenger to 'Uyayna ibn Hasan, who was the leader of the Ghatfan tribe that day fighting alongside Abu Sufyan.
كتاب الأموال: وَحَتَّى أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَسُولًا إِلَى عُيَيْنَةَ بْنِ حِصْنٍ وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ رَئِيسُ الْكُفَّارِ مِنْ غَطَفَانَ، وَهُوَ مَعَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) offered him a third of the fruit of the date palms of Madina if he would leave the alliance and return with the people of his tribe.
كتاب الأموال: فَعَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُلُثَ ثَمَرِ نَخْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، عَلَى أَنْ يَخْذُلَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَيَنْصَرِفَ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنْ غَطَفَانَ

THE: 'Uyayna replied, ‘Give me half the produce and I will do so.’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ عُيَيْنَةُ: بَلْ أَعْطِنِي شَطْرَ ثَمَرِهَا، ثُمَّ أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) then sent for Sa<d ibn Mu^dh, who was the chief of the Aws tribe, and for Sa'd ibn 'Ubada, who was the chief of al-Khazraj, and said, ‘I have been asked by 'Uyayna to give him half of the produce of your date palms so that he may take the members of the Ghatfan with him and go away leaving the alliance, whereas I had offered him a third.
كتاب الأموال: فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ وَهُوَ سَيِّدُ الْأَوْسِ وَإِلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ وَهُوَ سَيِّدُ الْخَزْرَجِ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ عُيَيْنَةَ قَدْ سَأَلَنِي نِصْفَ ثَمَرِ نَخْلِكُمْ، عَلَى أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ بِمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنْ غَطَفَانَ وَيَخْذُلَ الْأَحْزَابَ، وَإِنِّي أَعْطَيْتُهُ الثُّلُثَ،

THE: He has refused to accept, unless it is one-half. What then is your view?’
كتاب الأموال: فَأَبَى إِلَّا النِّصْفَ فَمَا تَرَيَانِ؟»

THE: Both of them said, ‘O Messenger of God, if you have been ordered (by God) to do so, do it.’
كتاب الأموال: قَالَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنْ كُنْتَ أُمِرْتَ بِشَيْءٍ فَافْعَلْهُ،

THE: The Messenger of God (pbuh) said, ‘If I had been ordered to do something, I would not have sought your instructions.
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَوْ أُمِرْتُ بِشَيْءٍ لَمْ أَسْتَأْمِرْكُمَا فِيهِ،

THE: This is just an opinion that I present to you.’
كتاب الأموال: وَلَكِنْ هَذَا رَأْيٌ أَعْرِضُهُ عَلَيْكُمَا»

THE: They said, Tn our opinion, we should give them nothing but the sword.’ The Messenger of God (pbuh) said, ‘So be it.’”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَا: فَإِنَّا لَا نَرَى أَنْ نُعْطِيَهُمْ إِلَّا السَّيْفَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «فَنَعَمْ»

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: Mu<awiya did this during his rule.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَقَدْ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ مُعَاوِيَةُ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ

THE: (450) Abu 'Ubayd said: Hisham ibn (Amm5r related to me from al-Walid ibn Muslim from Safwan ibn (Amr and Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz that the Byzantines made a peace settlement with Mu^wiya that they would pay him some wealth and he kept some of their men as security.
كتاب الأموال: 446 - قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّ الرُّومَ صَالَحَتْ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَلَى أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ إِلَيْهِمْ مَالًا، وَارْتَهَنَ مُعَاوِيَةُ مِنْهُمْ رَهْنًا

THE: He kept them at Ba^lbak. When the Byzantines acted treacherously, Mu^awiya and the Muslims refused to shed the blood of those who were in their custody as security, and they let them go.
كتاب الأموال: فَجَعَلَهُمْ بِبَعْلَبَكَّ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الرُّومَ غَدَرَتْ، فَأَبَى مُعَاوِيَةُ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَسْتَحِلُّوا قَتْلَ مَنْ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ مِنْ رَهْنِهِمْ، وَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُمْ،

THE: As a result of this they came out victorious against them. They said: “Returning uprightness for treachery is better than returning treachery for treachery.”
كتاب الأموال: وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا بِذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَقَالُوا: وَفَاءٌ بِغَدْرٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ غَدْرٍ بِغَدْرٍ

THE: (451) He said: Al-Awza'i has maintained a similar opinion: “The hostages (held as security) are not to be slain due to the treachery of the enemy.”
كتاب الأموال: 447 - قَالَ: وَقَالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ فِي مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ: لَا تَقْتُلِ الرَّهْنَ بِغَدْرِهِمْ

THE: The Policy of the Muslims After the Termination of Temporary Peace or Cessation of Hostilities
كتاب الأموال: بَابُ الصُّلْحِ وَالْمُوَادَعَةِ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ إِلَى وَقْتٍ، ثُمَّ يَنْقَضِي ذَلِكَ الْوَقْتُ، كَيْفَ يَنْبَغِي لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَنْ يَصْنَعُوا؟

THE: (452) Yazid ibn Harun related to us from Shu^ba from Abu al-Fayd from Sulaym ibn 'Amir, who said: “There was an agreement between some people from Byzantium and Mu<awiya, and he used to travel through their land.

كتاب الأموال: 448 - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْفَيْضِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ: كَانَ بَيْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَبَيْنَ نَاسٍ مِنَ الرُّومِ عَهْدٌ، فَكَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بِلَادِهِمْ

THE: He decided to attack them as soon as the agreement came to an end. He heard a man say, ‘God is great! Promises are to be fulfilled and there is to be no treachery.’
كتاب الأموال: فَأَرَادَ إِذَا انْقَضَى الْعَهْدُ أَنْ يُغِيرَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَفَاءٌ لَا غَدْرٌ،

THE: He asked, ‘Who is that?’
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ: مَنْ هَذَا؟

THE: They replied, ‘It is 'Amr ibn 'Abasa.’
كتاب الأموال: قَالُوا: عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَسَةَ،

THE: 'Amr said, ‘I heard the Messenger of God (pbuh) saying, “When someone has a compact with a people, he should not rescind it without informing them and giving them equal opportunity.” ’’,
كتاب الأموال: فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ عَهْدٌ فَلَا يَحِلَّ عُقْدَةً حَتَّى يَنْبِذَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ»

THE: Yazid said: Mu<awiya did not intend to attack them before the termination of the period of the covenant.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ يَزِيدُ: لَمْ يُرِدْ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَنْ يُغِيرَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَ انْقِضَاءِ الْمُدَّةِ،

THE: He did intend, however, that as soon as the period was over he would attack them unawares while he was still in their territory.
كتاب الأموال: وَلَكِنَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ تَنْقَضِيَ وَهُوَ فِي بِلَادِهِمْ فَيُغِيرَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ غَارُّونَ،

THE: This is what 'Abasa did not like and indicated that he should not enter their territory till he informed them that he intended to wage war on them.
كتاب الأموال: فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَسَةَ إِلَّا أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَ بِلَادَهُمْ حَتَّى يُعْلِمَهُمْ وَيُخْبِرَهُمْ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ غَزْوَهُمْ

THE: This, or something to that effect, is what Yazid said.
كتاب الأموال: هَذَا الْكَلَامُ أَوْ نَحْوُهُ قَالَهُ يَزِيدُ

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: This is how the Messenger of God (pbuh) treated all those with whom he had a covenant for a duration that came to an end.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَكَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِكُلِّ مَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ عَهْدٌ إِلَى مُدَّةٍ، ثُمَّ انْقَضَتْ،

THE: In fact, he gave them additional time. It is also what is prescribed in the Book.
كتاب الأموال: وَزَادَهُمْ فِي الْوَقْتِ أَيْضًا، وَبِذَلِكَ نَزَلَ الْكِتَابُ

THE: (453) Hajjsj related to us from Ibn Jurayj from Mujahid his commentary about the words of the Exalted: “A (declaration) of immunity from God and His Messenger, to those of the pagans with whom you have contracted mutual alliances.””
كتاب الأموال: 449 - حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى {بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ} [التوبة: 1]

THE: He said: “The people of such contracts are the KhuzS^, Madlaj and others.”
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: إِلَى أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ، مِن خُزَاعَةَ وَمُدْلِجٍ، وَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَهْدٌ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ،

THE: He said: “When the Messenger of God (pbuh) was free of the Battle of Tabnk, he decided to perform the pilgrimage (hajj) and said, ‘The polytheist also come to the Ka<ba and perform the circumambulation naked.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ: أَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ [ص:213] مِنْ تَبُوكَ، حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْهَا، فَأَرَادَ الْحَجَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ يَحْضُرُ الْبَيْتَ مُشْرِكُونَ يَطُوفُونَ عُرَاةً،

THE: I do not wish to perform the pilgrimage till this is stopped.’
كتاب الأموال: فَلَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَحُجَّ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ ذَلِكَ

THE: He then sent Aba Bakr and
كتاب الأموال: فَأَرْسَلَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعَلِيًّا، فَطَافَا فِي النَّاسِ بِذِي الْمَجَازِ بِأَمْكِنَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يَتَبَايَعُونَ فِيهَا كُلِّهَا، وَبِالْمَوْسِمِ كُلِّهِ، فَآذَنُوا أَصْحَابَ الْعَهْدِ بِأَنْ يَأْمَنُوا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرِ

THE: 'Ali and both of them went round at Dha al-MajSz through the markets and all the gathering places of pilgrims announcing to the people with truce agreements that they were to have four months of peace, after which their covenants would come to an end.
These were the four sacred months that stretched consecutively from 10th Dhu al-Hijja up to the 10th Rabi' al-Akhar?
كتاب الأموال: وَهِي الأشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ الْمُنْسَلِخَاتِ الْمُتَوَالِيَاتِ: عَشْرٌ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ إِلَى عَشْرٍ تَخْلُوَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَبِيعٍ الْآخَرَ، ثُمَّ لَا عَهْدَ لَهُمْ

THE: They announced war after this with all these people, unless they believed (in the faith).
كتاب الأموال: وَآذَنَ النَّاسَ كُلَّهُمْ بِالْقِتَالِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا

THE: (454) Ibn Jurayj said: 'Abd Allah ibn Kathir said: “Mujahid said: <A1I used to recite the verse and then say, “No polytheist will perform the pilgrimage after this year, and no naked person will perform the circumambulation of the Ka<ba?””M
كتاب الأموال: 450 - قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَقْرَأُ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لَا يَحُجَّنَّ بَعْدَ هَذَا الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلَا يَطُوفَنَّ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ.

THE: (455) Ibn Jurayj said: “'Ata’ was of the view that 'A1I used to begin the recitation with the word bar&a (immunity: the first verse) and end at the verse with the word astaqamu (stand true)?”
كتاب الأموال: 451 - قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: وَزَعَمَ عَطَاءٌ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا كَانَ يَسْتَفْتِحُ بَرَاءَةَ، حَتَّى يَخْتِمَ {فَمَا اسْتَقَامُوا لَكُمْ} [التوبة: 7] هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ.

THE: (456) Ibn Jurayj was of the view that Jabir ibn 'Abd Allah used to recite it at Mina.
كتاب الأموال: 452 - وَزَعَمَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: كَانَ يَقْرَؤُهَا بِمِنًى قَالَ [ص:214] أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: يَعْنِي عَلِيًّا

THE: (457) Hajjaj related to us from Ibn Jurayj from Mujahid that the four forbidden months in the verse “When the forbidden months are past”” are the months mentioned in the words “Go ye then for four months, (as ye will)”.
كتاب الأموال: 453 - وَحَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، {فَإِذَا انْسَلَخَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ} [التوبة: 5] الْأَرْبَعَةُ الَّتِي قَالَ: {فَسِيحُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ} [التوبة: 2]

THE: These months were forbidden so that they may be in peace and go forth in the land.
كتاب الأموال: وَهِيَ الْحُرُمُ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا فِيهَا، حَتَّى يُسَيِّحُوهَا

THE: Aba 'Ubayd said: Mujahid intends thereby that the Book does not mean here the sacred months that are mentioned in the words of the Exalted: “The number of months in the sight of God is twelve (in a year) - so ordained by Him the day He created the heavens and the earth; of them four are sacred.”*"
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: يُرِيدُ مُجَاهِدٌ: أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْنِ بِالْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ الَّتِي فِي قَوْلِهِ: {مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ} [التوبة: 36]

THE: Had he intended these, the period would have ended with the end of al-Muharram and the beginning of Safar.
كتاب الأموال: وَلَوْ أَرَادَ تِلْكَ لَكَانَ انْسِلَاخُهَا مَعَ خُرُوجِ الْمُحَرِّمِ وَاسْتِهْلَالِ صَفَرَ،

THE: He intended four months commencing with the day of sacrifice extending up to the 10th of Rabi' al-Akhar.
كتاب الأموال: وَلَكِنَّهُ أَرَادَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ مِنْ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ مُسْتَأْنَفَةً إِلَى عَشْرٍ مِنْ رَبِيعٍ الْآخَرِ،

THE: That is why he (Mujahid) explained: “This completes the four beginning with the day of sacrifice.”
كتاب الأموال: كَمَا قَالَ: وَذَلِكَ تَمَامُ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ.

THE: Abu 'Ubayd said: He called them protected due to the security and undertaking that granted to them.
كتاب الأموال: قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: وَإِنَمَا سَمَّاهَا حُرُمًا لِلْأَمَانِ وَالْعَهْدِ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُمْ،

THE: Their slaying was declared prohibited by him for himself.
كتاب الأموال: وَجَعَلَ قِتَالَهُمْ فِيهِنَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ حَرَامًا

THE: (458) Abu al-Yaman related to us from Shu^ayb ibn Abi Hamza from Ibn Shihab, who said: “Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab informed me that the Messenger of God (pbuh) performed umra from al-Ji'irrSna during Dha al-Qa^a, after he was free of the Battles of Hunayn and Ta’if.
كتاب الأموال: 454 - وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «اعْتَمَرَ مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ، بَعْدَمَا فَرَغَ مِنْ غَزْوَةِ حُنَيْنٍ وَالطَّائِفِ،

THE: He then went back to Madina and appointed Abu Bakr as the leader for the pilgrimage (hajj) that year.
كتاب الأموال: فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، ثُمَّ قَفَلَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَأَمَّرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ عَلَى تِلْكَ الْحِجَّةِ،

THE: He directed him to proclaim the verse(s) of immunity (^arJ’a).”
كتاب الأموال: وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ بِبَرَاءَةَ»

THE: (459) Ibn Shihab said: “Humayd ibn <Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf informed me that Abu Hurayra said: ‘Abu Bakr deputed me, among other proclaimed, on the day of sacrifice to proclaim that no polytheist would perform the pilgrimage after that year and that no one would circumambulate the Ka<ba naked.’”
